reviews.text:
Staff amazing
Plus front of waiting room is very clean as with no untowards smells

A really relaxed atmosphere

5 stars

Vet was nice. Receptionist was a different case. Called and asked if i can pay when i get there, then she told me that she wouldn’t have said that over the phone. Maybe listen to the reviews that say the receptionists are rude. It’s best to have someone kind greet you.
Excellent service ideal pricing for whatever animals you have.  I had my female cat doctored there.

We have used this vet for a long time, and recently we had to make the heartbreaking decision to have our  dog, Hugo, put to sleep.

When I called, they got us in very quickly. The vet who looked after us was so kind, compassionate, and understanding. They gave us plenty of time to say our final goodbye, which meant so much to us. They also asked if we would like a paw print and nose print as a keepsake.

We have since received these beautifully presented in a card, and our daughter has put them in a frame in her bedroom. It is such a thoughtful gesture and something she will treasure forever as a precious memory of Hugo.

Thank you to everyone involved for your kindness, care, and compassion during such a difficult time. It was a truly special touch that we will never forget. ❤️
The reception team, the nurses and the vets themselves are always very helpful.
A day later I still can’t get over the £104 I was charged to prescribe my cat some flea treatment! What a rip off for 3 mins weighing of my kitten!

This is the worst vets to take your pets they let my animal suffer when they could clearly see he wasn't going to make it through the day just to get more money out of me I asked for a box to take my pet home after they let him suffer they gave me a broken box with sellotape wrapped around it then had the cheek to ask for my payment while in the room with my decest pet never again will I take any of my pets here I wouldn't even give it a 1 star.

Excellent vets who really care for the animals recently taken our 2 guinea pigs and they received amaxing care from the vet. I have now also registered my dog with them. Its an amazing place you just get that feeling as soon as you walk through the door. Prices are reasonable too.

As my first time here I was concerned for my puppies health as I believed something was wrong with her, I went here and they booked me straight away which was good, only few bad things about this place, there’s this a little bit overweight man who is extremely disrespectful and rude and when you try to speak with him it seems like he’s got an attitude problem. The receptionist at the counter is extremely friendly and nice don’t remember her name.

I asked for a microchip and vaccination to be done along side the checkup for her health, they ignore or forgot about the microchip or vaccination and a vet only squeezed her stomach for a few minutes and then told me they need to do an X-ray which I’ll charge another 100 that day I was charged almost 150 just for a vet to squeeze her stomach and told me to sit down , I highly recommend a different vet house pets because not only did they check for any health issues, they vaccinated her, sorted me out with a microchip, somehow I paid less money at vet house pets whilst they also offered me a free bag of food.

Please don’t go here thank you :)
Lovely staff and still very reasonable pricing.
Used to love this vets but went today and found the receptionist very rude!
Excellent vets.

Absolutely disgusted by this vets. We took our dog to them a couple weeks ago due to a change In her behaviour. (She was getting snappy with one of us) the vet examined her and said they couldn’t see anything. We paid for a Physio to come out to our home and she noted that her back seemed to be causing reaction, her left leg wasn’t as muscular as her right and she wasn’t fully picking up that leg. She gave our dog light therapy and some exercises and our dog picked up for a few days. She suggested we do a pain trial for a few days. We contacted this vet and asked for a prescription as they had seen our dog just a couple weeks ago with the same problem. They said they wouldn’t dispense without the Physio report. We went in today to again ask how long it was until they could dispense our dog is also in season and is scared of the fireworks on top of everything else so she needed some relief asap. I was told that nothing could be done until they had the repost and even then they might not issue the medication. They said the only way to do it was see the vet (another £50 odd pounds) I said I wasn’t happy with that as they had already seen her about the same problem and she just needed to do the pain trial then we would go from there. (Our dogs insured) The receptionist (Lucy) seemed to have no empathy at all just didn’t take our word for the Pysio treatment our dog had received. It was obvious they just wanted to get our dog in (again) and for us to pay more money. A woman also dropped a cat in that had been run over whilst we was there and was questioned by a nurse on who it belonged to (it belongs to a neighbour she’s knows but doesn’t know the address) and the nurse said “oh funny that” as though the woman was telling lies! They are obviously money motivated and don’t care for animals at all. They used to be a ok vet have used them for around 2/3 years Liz the one receptionist is lovely but the other one and the nurse need to take a few customer service training days and perhaps reconsider working with pets and people. We called another vet who believes we have seen a Pysio will check her over and dispense the medication. I wasn’t going to pay twice at Vets 4 Pets as she has already been seen by them so I’ve now moved vets. No care or empathy just got ££££££ in the eyes no wonder the place was empty.

Friendly staff to welcome you.
Staff at all levels, knowledgeable and explained procedures and after care.
Bobby was well cared for.

They were absolutely brilliant!! We took a stray cat in for an abscess she got from bite - they were incredibly gentle with her, got the puss out and my cat did not struggle and looked very comfortable. They gave some really useful advice on how to manage the cats situation. The cat looks like it bounced back to health today and looks very happy. I definitely recommend this vet service all fur parents. We were not treated like just another customer. They gave us a brilliant service from the get go! The vet nurse and doctor were absolutely a gem of person

I’ve just registered my cat with this vet, and I honestly can’t find a single thing to fault. From the moment you walk in, everything is clean and fresh. The reception staff greet you with a genuine smile and kindness.

My baby boy, Tommy, had a little "accident" in his carrier on the way in, and they immediately took him and the carrier to be cleaned by a nurse — such thoughtful and caring service.

The vet (I believe her name was Delphina — apologies if I’ve spelled it wrong) was wonderful. She gave Tommy a full check-up after I explained my concerns about his health. She suspected it might just be a furball issue, gave him his vaccination, and explained everything clearly. I never felt rushed, pressured, or left out of what was happening with my boy.

I’ve also signed up for their health plan, which comes with lots of great benefits. I’m so glad I chose this practice for Tommy’s care!
Veterinarians are really nice here, clean facility, friendly and handled our kitten with care. Receptionist are not very welcoming, appear grumpy and uptight in person and over the phone.

Highly recommended vet practice. Very educated and knowledgeable in what they do. I have multiple pets with them. Cats and dog, every single visit is wicked, they take a alot of care, effort and passion in what they do. The price is fair and very clear with what your paying for. They support your anytime via whatsapp which is convenient and also quick. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!  Hugos Dad.

These guys are real heroes, I had a litter of kittens that had got tangled in 1 umbilical cord tieing themselves together. Originally phoned PDSA who would not help at all. Rang Vets for Pets, within 15 minutes the kittens were seen by the nurses who worked their magic and separated them. Thank you for giving them a chance ❤️
Called up on a Friday evening and got to see them Saturday at 10am. My cat was looked after and the problem sorted wonderfully
Always very helpful friendly and efficient, they really do care about your pet

well, I always feel ripped off after every appointment with my dog and will never going back here.
Paid £76 in total for annual vaccination and nothing else, vet just did basic heath check like listened heart and checked ears and eyes and that is it. I feel that this place having much higher rates then others, so I will move on this year to try someone else.

Well there’s a shock reading some of there’s reviews 100% avoid this place at all costs they’re running a business and only want your money. The communication is extremely poor.
And the treatment isn’t any better YouTube video coming soon avoid

It takes ages to talk to someone just to book an appointment, when someone finally answers they put you on hold for ages!!! Then very difficult to get an appointment. I have health care plan with them, as soon as it finishes I will go to another vet.
The staff are friendly very helpful and the head vet is genuinely concerned about the best treatment for your pets cannot fault them
Excellent practice. Vets and all other staff are brilliant. Highly recommend
Excellent vets, very caring they looked after our old cat Chloe Gitlie.

Thank you for helping me with Bruce when I bought him in last Monday, as he had sadly passed away at home. All the staff were very compassionate, and helped me to choose the right option (I chose an individual cremation, so I could bring him home.)
Vaccination for our 3 dogs and check up, all good, happy with service as always 😀 …
